notes.title: Demoversion for One Hundred Ways released
notes.content: Sunlight Games has released a demo version of One Hundred Ways. The demo version will enable players to try 15 of the current 115 levels and give them the opportunity to check out the game.

notes.title: Sunlight Games expands One Hundred Ways by 15 new levels
notes.content: Puzzle freaks watch out: Sunlight Games expands the successfully started puzzle-game One Hundred Ways by 15 free levels for free. The patch 1.1.5 will be released today on Steam for PC and Mac. It will also be included in the Linux- version at release.

notes.title: One Hundred Ways, Update to 1.1 released!
notes.content:
[h1]One Hundred Ways, Update to 1.1 released! Patch notes below.[/h1]

- Complete new interface
- New robot animation
- New level-map
- Some minor changes in Level 13, 24, 36, 41, 45 and 63
- Background flashes/animation slower
See patchnotes to 1.0.5 too!

notes.title: One Hundred Ways, Update to 1.0.5 released!
notes.content:
[h1]One Hundred Ways, Update to 1.0.5 released! Patch notes below.[/h1]
- Button click sound changed
- Scrollbar fixed in level 100
- Some minor text changes
- Reset button added to start the level new, without going back to the map
- Inventory will be closed after clicking outside it
- Map-position will be saved on the last position
